clusters.mechanism: The scripts/smoke.ts refactor is unrequested scope creep that exceeds the ~200-line budget and changes `--models` behavior.
When allowed verifiers remain but all of them raised the current candidate, pickVerifier() throws a generic independence error and drops the origin-exclusion reasons.
The fixed three-second readiness deadline in the existing smoke test is flaky when the child process starts slowly.
The private-output NoCapacityError message joins the raw origin reasons without deduplication, so identical reasons repeat.
